# PlanBridge

> Better code with inline comments on your coding agent plans.

PlanBridge is a lightweight, open-source tool that opens coding agent plans in a local browser window. Reviewers can highlight text, leave inline comments, approve the plan, or request changes before code is written.

PlanBridge fits into existing workflows, uses standard agent hooks and plugins, and uninstalls easily if you change your mind.

## Primary Links

- Homepage: https://plan.contextbridge.ai/
- Quickstart: https://plan.contextbridge.ai/quickstart/
- Install: https://plan.contextbridge.ai/install/
- How it works: https://plan.contextbridge.ai/how-it-works/
- Claude Code usage: https://plan.contextbridge.ai/usage/claude-code/
- Codex CLI usage: https://plan.contextbridge.ai/usage/codex/
- Other agents: https://plan.contextbridge.ai/usage/other-agents/
- GitHub repository: https://github.com/contextbridge/planbridge

## Summary

PlanBridge helps developers steer AI coding agents at plan time. It opens the agent's proposed plan as rendered markdown in a local browser UI, supports text selection and inline comments, and sends approved or requested-change feedback back through the agent's normal integration point.
